adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `TopicEmbed.import_remote`, which fetches remote HTML (`open(url).read`), extracts `doc.content` with Readability allowing `a`/`img` tags and `href`/`src` attributes, then imports it as a post with `cook_method: :raw_html` (bypassing the cooking/sanitization pipeline in `Post#cook`) and renders it via `raw post.cooked` in `app/views/embed/best.html.erb`. The diff itself contains no URL-scheme validation for `href`/`src` (it only rewrites relative URLs starting with '/'), so any `javascript:` (or similar) URLs present in the extracted HTML would be persisted and served to clients.
